new.action: Put text or numbers on thumbnails

Shorter titles go with higher Top Trending positions among games of similar age
Games whose descriptions advertise redeem codes rank lower on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age

new.statement: Ragdoll physics sandboxes (fall, fling and break your avatar with realistic limp-body physics) are a fresh wave that reaches Up-and-Coming, Top Trending and Most Popular within two weeks of launch
new.rationale: Ragdoll Reality (11 days) leads Top Trending momentum (+42), sits second on Up-and-Coming and entered Most Popular today; [UPD] Realistic Ragdoll Engine (12 days) entered Up-and-Coming. Both sell many passes (16 and 5) with few products, and sandbox_physics has the best median Top Trending percentile (84) of any loop, though from only 3 games. Confirm if more ragdoll titles appear and these two hold past week 4; watch for the curiosity fade seen in the device-game wave (H-x-017).

qualitative_updates.note: The Hollow (11 days) is now among the best on both Most Popular and Up-and-Coming; Flee the Facility rose +47 and DOORS +21 on Most Popular, and DOORS entered Top Trending. The lift on participating games is holding through the event; the post-Oct 31 reversal is still the real test, and Halloween remains a confounder.

More evidence of fade: Steal a Wild Horse is among the weakest on Up-and-Coming, Don't Steal My Eggs! fell off Most Popular and Top Trending, and 'Steal' in titles goes with lower Up-and-Coming positions (r=-0.35) and Top Earning efficiency (r=-0.34), while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular.

Moped Drag rose +197 on Top Earning after a big update, Escooter Life (13 days) rose +14 and Southern Mudding +18 on Most Popular, and Bike Universe and Backseat Rally are among the best on Up-and-Coming; racing_driving holds a median Up-and-Coming percentile of 73. The niche keeps widening.
DONT SPLASH (7 days) is #1 on Up-and-Coming; HUSH: They can hear. fell -25, so only the leader of the cluster is holding. Held.
Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) is again among the best for Top Trending momentum and Animal Hospital (Anomaly), 167 days, entered Top Trending; the genre keeps producing entries.
Beat Up Verity (21 days) entered Up-and-Coming, another small game riding the Verity meme. Held.
Undertale Adventures X (830 days, a tower defense on a game fandom) entered Top Earning and Candy Kingdom Defense (Adventure Time) rose +133. Two more data points, still untested by the scan.
